name: Johannesburg
housing: Johannesburg renters live in townhouses in security complexes, apartments, and garden cottages behind houses.

localRules.text: South African landlords must keep the deposit in an interest-bearing account and refund it with interest, less any agreed costs.

tenantHelp.name: Gauteng Rental Housing Tribunal

climate: Photograph the roof and ceilings for leaks and test the geyser; Johannesburg summers bring heavy afternoon thunderstorms.
fact: Many Johannesburg rentals are townhouses in gated complexes with their own body corporate rules.
